types.name: Tabs
types.text: The kinds of skill the character knows. Level Up lists the skills that can be learned now.

search.name: Search and sort
search.text: Filters the list by name and changes its order.

grid.name: Skills
grid.text: Every skill in the open tab. Pick one to see its card on the right page.

loadout.name: Loadout
loadout.text: The nine skills carried into battle. Only these can be cast in a fight; Best and Random fill the strip for you.

sync.name: Sync and Desync
sync.text: Sync puts the selected skill in the loadout, Desync takes it out. Some skills are always carried and spend no slot.

card.name: Skill card
card.text: Cost, element, damage and effects of the selected skill, and Use to cast it outside battle.

help.name: ? Help
help.text: Opens this sheet. On a controller, press Select; press it again, Back or Confirm to close.

list.name: Skills
list.text: The skills this character carries into battle. Pick one to cast it.

cost.name: Cost
cost.text: The MP or AP a skill spends. A skill the character cannot afford is dimmed.

weapon.name: Weapon needs
weapon.text: A skill marked Needs melee or Needs ranged works only with that kind of weapon in hand.

target.name: Target
target.text: A skill aimed at an ally asks who it lands on after being picked.
